meta.description: Boutique hotel in Lara, Antalya with views of the Mediterranean and the Taurus Mountains. Bed & breakfast, outdoor pool, spa and Dialogue Coffee & Kitchen.

hero.title: A boutique stay facing the Mediterranean
hero.text: In Şirinyalı, with views of the sea and the Taurus Mountains — comfort with a personal touch.

booking.label: Availability search
booking.note: You can add children on the booking page.

intro.title: By the sea, in the heart of the city
intro.text: Our hotel in Şirinyalı pairs views of the Mediterranean and the Taurus Mountains with the warmth of a boutique hotel. Start the day with breakfast overlooking the sea at Dialogue Coffee & Kitchen, just across the street.

rooms.title: A room for every kind of stay

dialogue.title: Good food, a view and conversation
dialogue.text: Just across from the hotel, on the cliffs, Dialogue Coffee & Kitchen is where you start the day with breakfast facing the sea — and where the same view keeps you company for the rest of the day.

experiences.title: The details that complete your stay

pool.title: Outdoor Pool
pool.text: Cool off in the outdoor pool, lined with sun loungers.

spa.title: Spa & Massage
spa.text: Leave the day behind at Avşar Spa.

breakfast.title: Breakfast with a View
breakfast.text: Breakfast is included in your stay.

location.title: Lara Location
location.text: Close to Old Lara Road and Terra City.

cta.title: Your own escape in Antalya
cta.text: Use our online booking system for live rates and availability, or message us on WhatsApp.

standard-land-view.name: Standard Land View Room
standard-land-view.description: At 15 m², the Standard Land View Room is a simple, comfortable choice for two. Breakfast is served with a sea view at Dialogue Coffee & Kitchen, just across the street.

standard-sea-view.name: Standard Sea View Room
standard-sea-view.description: Wake up to the Mediterranean in the 20 m² Standard Sea View Room — ideal for two guests.

partial-sea-view.name: Partial Sea View Room
partial-sea-view.description: With windows that take in part of the sea, this room offers a sea-view option for two guests.

comfort-sea-view.name: Comfort Sea View Room
comfort-sea-view.description: The 20 m² Comfort Sea View Room pairs a sea view with space for up to three guests with an extra bed.

superior-land-view.name: Superior Land View Room
superior-land-view.description: The spacious 25 m² Superior Land View Room welcomes up to three guests with an extra bed.

deluxe-sea-view.name: Deluxe Sea View Room
deluxe-sea-view.description: The 30 m² Deluxe Sea View Room offers generous space and a view of the Mediterranean, for up to three guests with an extra bed.

superior-sea-view.name: Superior Sea View Room
superior-sea-view.description: One of only two rooms on the hotel’s top floor, the 35 m² Superior Sea View Room is our largest sea-view room — for up to three guests with an extra bed.

dialoguePage.lead: Just across from the hotel, on the cliffs. Start the day with breakfast facing the Mediterranean and end it with the same view.
dialoguePage.introText: Dialogue Coffee & Kitchen is where our guests start the day and keep coming back to. Breakfast, a coffee break or dinner with the sea and the Taurus Mountains in view — all in the same warm atmosphere.

breakfast.title: Breakfast
breakfast.text: Breakfast is included for hotel guests and served facing the sea.

meals.title: Lunch and dinner
meals.text: The kitchen opens around 11:00 and the full menu is served until 23:00.

music.title: Live music
music.text: Dinner with live music on most weekend evenings.

experiencesPage.lead: From the outdoor pool to the spa, from breakfast with a view to Lara’s seaside walks — everything that completes your stay.

pool.title: Outdoor Pool
pool.text: Enjoy the sun and the water in our outdoor pool, lined with sun loungers.

spa.title: Spa & Massage
spa.text: Leave the day behind at Avşar Spa. Contact reception for treatments and appointments.

dining.title: Dialogue Coffee & Kitchen
dining.text: Breakfast is included in your stay and served facing the sea, just across from the hotel. À la carte dining through the day and live music on most weekends.

location.title: In Lara, right by the sea
location.text: Our hotel in Şirinyalı is close to Old Lara Road and Terra City, with clifftop walks and the city’s restaurants a short stroll away.
